description: Four fictional claims about a public CTIS trial listing Greece. One claim is deliberately misleading and one quotation is invented. This fixture tests quote location, not medical correctness.

candidates.quote: To compare PFS, based on a Local Investigator assessment between investigational (palazestrant with ribociclib + letrozole-matching placebo) and control (letrozole with ribociclib + palazestrant-matching placebo) arms.
candidates.claim: The main goal compares an outcome between two study groups.

candidates.quote: Να συγκριθεί η επιβίωση χωρίς εξέλιξη της νόσου (PFS)
candidates.claim: Ο κύριος στόχος περιλαμβάνει σύγκριση της επιβίωσης χωρίς εξέλιξη της νόσου.
Every adult can join this study.

candidates.quote: All adults are eligible with no other requirements.
candidates.claim: Every adult can join without other requirements.
